photo20_close_observation: The left lock plate turns clockwise in the camera view. The right plate has a shallower opposing angle. A small padlock hangs at the left plate, while a slender link runs rightward across the open seam.
limit: The four raised traditional characters over the lintel are visible in image 19. The model stops at the timber opening.
physical_scale: 原门没有同平面标尺。按照片透视校正，以门扇总净宽约1.63米估算板宽和钉距。背面与板厚按几何封合；两扇的前后偏差、木纹、铁件厚度和局部磨损均为估算。
